sous_titre: Livre de coloriage bilingue français-anglais pour enfants de 4 à 8 ans
style_prompt: black and white coloring page for children aged 4-8, thick clean black outlines, simple large shapes, no shading, no gray, no color, pure white background, cute friendly cartoon style, full page illustration, no text

pages.prompt: a happy African family of five (grandmother, mother, father, a girl and a boy) standing together and smiling in front of their house
an African grandmother sitting on a chair braiding the hair of a smiling little girl sitting on a small stool
